_format: skill-creator eval format — see https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions.

evals.prompt: I need to test the hotfix/payment-rounding branch in the browser while keeping my main checkout running. Set me up.
assertions: Announces it is using the worktree-herd-dev skill
Uses worktree-herd-setup with the branch name instead of hand-rolling git worktree + herd link + .env edits
Tells the user the resulting .test URL and how to start the per-worktree dev server (or that build_assets covers it)
Checks for the one-time scripts/install.sh prerequisite when the commands are missing

evals.prompt: I'm done with the payment-rounding worktree — get rid of it and its site.
assertions: Uses worktree-herd-cleanup (offering --dry-run to show the plan) instead of rm -rf plus manual herd unlink
Respects the tool's refusals (uncommitted changes, unresolvable site) rather than forcing through them
Only passes --force/--yes when the user explicitly accepts the risk

evals.prompt: Every branch we test needs its own database so testers stop trampling each other's data. Make that the default for this project.
assertions: Sets database: per-worktree in worktree-herd.yml (project config) rather than only passing --db once
Mentions the database is created + migrated on setup and dropped on cleanup
Points at .worktree-herd/post-setup hooks for seeders/admin users when the user needs seeded data
